title: Checkout 5xx Error Spike
checks: Compare 5xx rate by endpoint and region for the last 30 minutes.
Inspect recent checkout-api deploys and feature flag changes.
Sample failed traces and group by exception class.
mitigations: Disable the newest checkout payment-path feature flag if failures are isolated to the new path.
Rollback the latest checkout-api deploy if errors started within the deploy window.
Route traffic away from unhealthy checkout pods if failures are node-local.
escalation: Page checkout-api primary owner, payments on-call, and the incident commander if customer checkout failures continue for more than 15 minutes.

title: Payment Token Validation Failures
symptoms: Issuer or audience claims are rejected
checks: Compare token validation errors by client version.
Check auth header parsing changes and upstream identity provider health.
mitigations: Revert token parsing changes if failures map to a recent release.
Temporarily bypass strict issuer enforcement only with incident commander approval.
escalation: Engage the payments platform owner and security reviewer before changing token validation policy.
